title: How decentralized AI networks are challenging Big Tech

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your data could earn you money instead of being sold?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Big Tech controls 90% of global AI training data — and it’s not fair.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Decentralized AI networks let users own and monetize their data directly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Projects like Ocean Protocol use blockchain to securely share data without middlemen.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This disrupts companies like Google and Meta by giving power back to individuals.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of AI might not be controlled by a few giants — but by millions of users.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to join the movement rewriting the rules of AI?
